contexts.text: A tumult heard like a great turbulent revolution. SE 3584.
The speech of many Spirits heard undulating like a wave. AC 6923.
There rose up from the Lower Earth as it were a volume (of Spirits). SE 3531, below.
The roll, in Ezekiel and the little book, in the Revelation = truth Divine...
A long roll fastened to rods, seen. SE 2821.

Humiliation was represented by the letting down of their volume (of Spirits); for that company then appeared as a volume (or roll)... But the volume appeared as if hollowed out in the middle, and elevated at the sides. AC 7170. SE 3238.
(The Spirits of the Fourth Earth) were seen as a volume. Described. SE 3267.
The Angels can utter in a few words all the things written in a volume of any book.
They write volumes (about faith, only).
This work would expand into a large volume.
If a man merely runs over a volume with his eyes...
They act like a wave of the sea.
He whirled round as it were a roll in the form of a fish, (which) = his natural things.
A thousand (confirming) volumes might be written.
The Spirits of Mercury spoke in a volume...
They saluted them in a volume. Explained.
They might fill the greatest library with volumes...
There rose up... a volume, or wave of people. In the other life such waves, or volumes, are people. These rose up thus in a volume.
These Spirits affected the brain like a soft and almost watery wave... This undulating volume adhered to the head.
His sphere was rolled round him like a roll extended in length, according to the roundness of a roll, (Further described.)
A roll of a book written in front and behind () = the state of the Church then, thus the quality of the life of those of the Church. ( = the Word. AE 622:2.)

By a book, when mentioned in the Word, is meant a roll; for in ancient times it was written upon parchments, which were rolled together, and the parchment is called a book, and the roll of a book. Illustrated. AE 404:end.
The roll of a book which Jehoiakim burnt () = the Word...
A flying roll (). Explained.
These ethers and airs, when acted upon in a volume, give heat...
